summary: A narrator leaves a meeting with an old lawyer, who has just warned that using a secure phone is only for emergencies, and rides to the federal courthouse where a protest is gathering. The scene describes the crowd, including activists, plainclothes and uniformed officers, and drummers, with wry commentary on protest culture. The narrator is wary of surveillance and meets Nikko away from the crowd, where they discuss the police presence and hand over a secure phone.
one_line: The narrator rides to a federal courthouse protest, wary of police and surveillance, and passes a secure phone to Nikko.
key_facts: The old lawyer tells the narrator that the secure phone is only for emergencies and hopes it will not be needed.
The narrator goes outside and rides a bike to the federal courthouse, where a protest is gathering.
The narrator notes the lawyer said the phone could go wrong but did not say it would make things worse for Wilson.
A bossy activist with a loud speaker shouts things nobody can hear clearly at the courthouse protest.
Officers wearing coats reading POLICE or FEDERAL MARSHAL stand around with feet spread and eyes hidden behind dark glasses.
The narrator says FBI agents are mingling in plain clothes in the crowd, trying to blend in.
Some protesters wear scarves printed to look like Anonymous, a mask based on a comic-book version of a Catholic man who tried to blow up Parliament.
Nikko straddles a fixed gear bike at the edge of the crowd, imagining how he would stage the scene.
The narrator says the scene would look different in North Minneapolis, where the crowd is black instead of almost all white.
The narrator asks Nikko to wait a few minutes before following him, and Nikko looks puzzled at the instruction.
The narrator kneels to fix a bike chain at a spot without obvious surveillance cameras, where traffic noise provides white noise.
Nikko asks Need some help and then says too many cops are over there.
The narrator answers that there are too many cops who are not in uniform and says I have that secure phone for you.
